Head_and_Face: Head is broad and flattened with a broad, U-shaped snout (wider than crocodile's V-shaped snout).
When mouth is closed, upper teeth completely obscure lower teeth.
Eyes are small, dark, positioned dorsally with vertical slit pupils.
Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is massive and heavily armored.
Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
Scutes are dark grey to black with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
Ventral surface lacks bony scutes and is covered in smooth, pale scales with dark spots.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Limbs are short and stout with webbed hind feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.

Head_and_Face: Three prominent horns: two long brow horns projecting forward and upward above the eyes, and a shorter nasal horn on the snout.
Beak is parrot-like with a sharp, keratinous cutting edge.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is quadrupedal with columnar, elephant-like limbs.
Enormous bony frill (neck shield) extending posteriorly from the skull, with width dramatically exceeding the skull itself.
Frill is solid bone with a smooth outer surface and possible epoccipital (marginal) bumps.
Skin is inferred to have been covered in large, hexagonal scales with possible quill-like structures along the back and tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.

Head_and_Face: Head is small, rounded, and barely distinct from the body with a blunt, rounded snout.
Eyes are minute and dark, barely visible beneath head scales.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender, worm-like and cylindrical.
Coloration is pinkish-brown to reddish-brown dorsally.
Ventral surface is pale pink to white.
Scales are smooth, glossy, and arranged in regular rows creating a sleek, reflective appearance.
No distinctive patterning; uniform coloration throughout.

Head_and_Face: Head is small and barely distinct from the body with a rounded snout and small, dark eyes.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender and cylindrical.
Bright yellow, orange, or cream-colored ring (collar) encircling the neck immediately behind the head.
Dorsal surface is uniformly dark grey, olive, or black with a glossy, smooth scale texture.
Ventral surface is bright yellow, orange, or red with a row of dark spots or chevrons along the midline.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is relatively long and slender with a pointed tip.
Scales are smooth and glossy without keels.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and distinct from the neck with large, dark eyes and a rounded profile.
Most distinctive feature is the upturned, pig-like snout (rostral scale modified into a pointed, upward-curving projection).
Body_and_Plumage: Body is stout.
Dorsal coloration is variable: grey, brown, olive, or reddish with dark blotches or bands.
Scales are keeled (ridged) creating a rough, textured appearance.
Ventral surface is pale with irregular dark mottling.

Head_and_Face: Head is narrow and pointed, barely distinct from the body, with large eyes and round pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is extremely elongated and cylindrical.
Dorsal surface is uniformly bright green (juvenile) to yellowish-green (adult).
Ventral surface is pale yellow to white.
Scales are smooth and glossy without keels, creating a sleek, reflective surface.
Uniform green coloration with no patterning.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is extremely slender with a thread-like diameter relative to length, creating a whip-like appearance.
Tail is long and tapering to a fine point.

Head_and_Face: Head is slightly distinct from the neck with a rounded snout and small, dark eyes with round pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is robust and cylindrical.
Coloration varies significantly by subspecies: alternating black and white/yellow bands, black with yellow chain-link pattern, or black with red and white bands.
Scales are smooth and glossy with a highly reflective surface creating a polished appearance.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is stout and muscular, adapted for constriction of prey.
Tail is relatively short and blunt.

Head_and_Face: Head is slightly distinct from the neck with a rounded snout and large, dark eyes with round pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender and cylindrical.
Three yellow, green, or white stripes running the length of the body: one dorsal stripe along the midline and two lateral stripes on each side, set against a dark brown, olive, or black background.
Scales are keeled (ridged) creating a rough, matte texture.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is long and tapering to a fine point, comprising approximately one-third of total length.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and distinct from the neck with a blunt snout and large eyes positioned laterally.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is robust and heavily-built cylindrical.
Dorsal coloration is dark brown, olive, or reddish-brown with dark crossbands or blotches that become less distinct with age.
Scales are strongly keeled (ridged) creating a rough, textured appearance.
Ventral surface is pale yellow to white with dark crescent-shaped or rectangular markings along the edges.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is relatively short and laterally compressed, aiding in swimming.

Head_and_Face: Head is extremely narrow and pointed with a sharply elongated snout.
Eyes are large and forward-facing with horizontal keyhole-shaped pupils.
Head profile is triangular when viewed from above.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is extremely elongated and laterally compressed, mimicking a vine or twig.
Body is bright green dorsally with a white or yellow ventral surface.
Green coloration is uniform with no patterning.
Scales are smooth and glossy with a slight iridescent sheen.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is extremely slender with a thread-like diameter relative to length, mimicking a vine or twig in cross-section.
Tail is long and prehensile, capable of gripping branches.
